components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font: 500 14px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action for copy or alternate workflows.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font: 500 14px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--accent-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Source Badge
components.description: Compact metadata label for the detected source platform.
components.css: .ds-source-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--secondary, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--secondary-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); padding: 2px 8px; font: 400 12px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-source-badge:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Compact note field with clear focus treatment.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-textarea" placeholder="备注（可选，会写入 frontmatter）"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-textarea { display: flex; min-height: 56px; width: 100%; resize: vertical; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-textarea:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Markdown Preview
components.description: Scrollable monospace preview block that leads the popup.
components.css: .ds-markdown-preview { height: 240px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)) 40%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); padding: 12px; font: 400 12px/1.625 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview: This system is a compact work surface for clipping knowledge. It should feel calm, precise, and restrained: a place where the user can inspect Markdown, add a note, and send the result onward without visual noise. The visual language is intentionally familiar. It uses neutral surfaces, small type, clear borders, modest radii, and standard product controls.
keyCharacteristics: Dense enough for repeated popup use.
Neutral-first, with color reserved for state and primary action.
Border and tonal layers before shadow.
Familiar controls with visible hover, focus, disabled, loading, and error states.
Text preview is the hero; chrome stays quiet.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Primary ink is for the action that matters now. Do not spend it on decoration.

rules.name: The Neutral Honesty Rule
rules.body: Gray roles must stay functional: surface, border, muted copy, focus, or state. No ornamental gray gradients.

rules.name: The No Display Drama Rule
rules.body: Product UI labels never use display typography, oversized headings, or decorative font pairings.

rules.name: The Preview Leads Rule
rules.body: Monospace belongs to the Markdown preview, not to the whole product. Do not let it turn the interface into terminal styling.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. If a shadow becomes visually noticeable before interaction, it is probably too much.

dos: Do keep the popup dense and task-first; the Markdown preview is the primary content.
Do use the neutral tokens from `assets/tailwind.css` instead of inventing new grays.
Do reserve Action Ink for primary action, active emphasis, and essential state.
Do show status with text and iconography, not color alone.
Do keep motion to state feedback between `150ms` and `250ms`, with reduced-motion alternatives.
donts: Don't make this look like a SaaS marketing surface with gradients, inflated cards, hero metrics, or decorative motion.
Don't over-mimic Obsidian with a heavy plugin aesthetic or unnecessary darkness.
Don't introduce terminal or hacker styling; monospace is for Markdown preview only.
Don't add glassmorphism, colored side-stripe borders, gradient text, or oversized rounded cards.
Don't use shadow as atmosphere. If a card needs structure, use border and tonal fill first.
